decisions.reason: The plug-in line builds on the established offer, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so the option is cheap to keep open while demand evidence keeps accumulating.

The building digital twin service is still only mentioned and its value remains uncertain, but digital twins are an emerging field tied to the firm's research and standards work, so a low-cost option is worth holding a while longer.

With the overlapping identity service E already withdrawn, the delegation service may be the remaining vehicle for this capability, so it stays as a cheap option, though its weak visibility raises the risk of later consolidation.
The consulting workshop was launched only in 2024, has its own page, uses existing consultants and trainers at little extra cost, and it is far too early for its results to show its value.
